listing.name: Breath of Fire IV — bof4-recomp (plaught-armor)
listing.summary: Native title runtime described; exact campaign/scene completion and package route not established here. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-01324 CUE with all data and audio tracks. This guide does not specify the exact accepted file hash.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow setup.sh or setup.bat to check the USA executable, translate game code and build the native bof4 player with Odin and SDL2. Keep your original disc data available.
